_method: Each crop opened and judged by eye. precision = correct / (correct + wrong); unclear excluded from the denominator. precision_strict = correct / (correct + wrong + unclear) also given.

wrong_examples.why: Bar chart of cell viability vs power density (W/cm2); no image of a sample. Axis tick text like '0.5'/'1.25' plus a unit was read as a scale bar.

unclear_examples.why: Composite crop: device schematic + energy-level diagram on the left, real SEM images with 1 um / 50 um scale bars on the right. Micrograph is true of part of the crop only.

wrong_examples.why: Acoustic-emission spectra, intensity vs frequency (kHz). The annotation 'Grain Size d=48um' / 'd=69um' inside the plot was read as a scale bar.
Bar chart of H2 evolution rate; the category labels are wavelengths ('>420 nm', '365 nm', '450 nm') and the 'nm' tokens fired the scale-bar rule.

DIS_micrograph.notes: DIS_micrograph__10.1016_s1359-6454(03)00293-3__c7e2997f0e5b83.jpg is a genuine micrograph but carries a full SEM banner (Acc.V 12.0 kV, SE, WD 7.0); scored correct, but it should have landed in SEM, so the two patterns overlap.

wrong_examples.why: bar chart, axis numbers+unit read as scale bar
AE frequency spectrum, 'Grain Size d=48um' caption read as scale bar
bar chart with wavelength ('nm') category labels

SEM.notes: Every crop shows an explicit instrument banner (SEI/BSE/SE2, kV, WD, Mag, TESCAN/ZEISS/FEI footer) over a real electron image. No failure mode observed.

wrong_examples.why: XAS/XANES Ru K-edge absorption spectrum, 22.10-22.20 keV. A keV x-axis is not sufficient: hard-X-ray absorption edges use the same unit.
AFM software screenshot: surface/horiz/vert distance measurement table over a height profile, not a composition profile.
Bar chart, zone-of-inhibition Distance [mm] vs E. coli concentration; microbiology, not composition.
Filopodial length / total extension distance (um) vs time (min); cell-biology kinetics.
Nanoscratch test: depth (um) and friction vs scratch distance (mm); mechanical, not composition.
Confocal PL schematic plus a polar intensity plot; only a stray 'Distance (nm)' token from a neighbouring panel.
Conductivity vs gate voltage transfer curve; the annotation 'Channel Distance = 10.5 um' fired the rule.
Interparticle distance (nm) vs polymer Mw, with TEM insets; distance is the y value, not a scan axis.
Grain-boundary migration distance (um) vs 1/G driving force, plus micrograph strips.
EBSD misorientation profile (degrees) vs distance [microns]; a line profile but of orientation, not composition.
CVD tube-furnace schematic with a 'Distance' dimension arrow; no plot at all.
Modulus E (GPa) and yield stress (MPa) vs Distance (um) through a graded tissue; mechanical profile.
Distance from centerline (mm) vs solidification parameter G^3/R; casting model, not a scan.

correct_examples.why: STEM BF + STEM EDX maps with Al concentration [at%] vs distance [um] across the interface.
